fields.rule_reference: Rajasthan Registration of Births and Deaths Rules, 2000 — Rule 5(2); Rajasthan RBD (Amendment) Rules, 2025
fields.notes: Information shall be given within twenty one days from the date of birth, death and still birth (Rule 5(2), 2000 Rules). No fee applies. No authority permission required.

fields.rule_name: Delayed Registration — Rajasthan (after 21 days, within 30 days)
fields.authority_notes: The Registrar may register the event on payment of the late fee. No formal authority permission order is required for this category.
fields.rule_reference: Rajasthan Registration of Births and Deaths (Amendment) Rules, 2025 — Rule 5(a), amending Rule 9(i) of 2000 Rules
fields.notes: Source text (Rule 9(i) as amended): after the expiry of the period specified in rule 5, but within thirty days of its occurrence, shall be registered on payment of a late fee of twenty rupees.

fields.rule_name: Delayed Registration — Rajasthan (after 30 days, within 1 year)
fields.authority_notes: Written permission of the District Registrar or the Block Statistical Officer or any other officer authorized by the Chief Registrar (Births and Deaths). Form No. 14 (self-attested document) must be produced.
fields.rule_reference: Rajasthan Registration of Births and Deaths (Amendment) Rules, 2025 — Rule 5(b)(ii), amending Rule 9(ii) of 2000 Rules; RBD (Amendment) Act, 2023 — Section 13(2)
fields.notes: Source verbatim: shall be registered only with the written permission of the District Registrar or the Block Statistical Officer or any other officer authorized by the Chief Registrar (Births and Deaths) in this behalf and on payment of a late fee of fifty rupees and on production of self-attested document, electronically or otherwise, in Form No. 14.

fields.authority_notes: Order made by the District Magistrate or Sub-Divisional Magistrate or by Executive Magistrate authorized by the District Magistrate, having jurisdiction over the area where the birth or death had taken place.
fields.rule_reference: Rajasthan Registration of Births and Deaths (Amendment) Rules, 2025 — Rule 5(b)(iii), amending Rule 9(iii) of 2000 Rules; RBD (Amendment) Act, 2023 — Section 13(3)
fields.notes: Source verbatim: shall be registered only on an Order made by the District Magistrate or Sub-Divisional Magistrate or by Executive Magistrate authorized by the District Magistrate, having jurisdiction over the area where the birth or death had taken place and on payment of a late fee of one hundred rupees.
